Name: Em's Pet Adoptions (more pets)
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Have one pet? Get all the pets!
This mod removes the need for full pet friendship to open up Marnie's Pet Adoption menu
Now all you need is to have at least one pet on your farm and one night's sleep
Pet adoptions are also more affordable

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vHynPJ0C/Howitworks.png[/img]﻿

After installing the mod, you start up your game as usual
After a good day on the farm, you tuck yourself in and sleep
The next morning, you received a letter from Marnie
She now offers pet adoptions at her ranch!

Not only can you now adopt all the pets, but they are also more affordable
After all, they need a good home. Marnie minds only that, not the costs
Pet Adoptions are 400 gold pieces

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

﻿Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Pet Adoptions"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy![url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rivalrabbit/mods?gameId=1303]
[/url]
[i]Thank you, Harrison, my knight in pixel armour, for always being so kind to help me with the script!
Or have a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37201]Em's Cats[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38357]Em's Dogs[/url] (or even [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38651]Em's Turtles[/url])[/i]
